query: How do I create a calculated metric for average order value in Customer Journey Analytics?

results.title: Installing extensions in Adobe Experience Platform Tags
results.content: To install an extension, open your tag property, select Extensions > Catalog, find the extension, and select Install.

results.title: Data elements
results.content: Data elements are variables that map to pieces of data on your site, such as a page name or a cookie value.
